E0415

Section visibility labels `pub:` / `priv:` rejected (D-VISDEFAULT2 option C)

What

Section visibility labels `pub:` / `priv:` rejected (D-VISDEFAULT2 option C)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0415

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0415: tests/ui/pub_file_section_label.stderr.

Error [E0415]: section visibility labels like `pub:` / `priv:` are not supported
  --> tests/ui/pub_file_section_label.jet:3:1
    |
  3 | pub:
    | ^^^^
 Why: moving an item above or below a label would silently change whether it exports
 Fix: write `#PubFile` once at the top of the file, then mark exceptions with `priv`
